title: Startup Clubhouse
description: The Startup Clubhouse was created as a more open environment for startup founders, employees and people looking for opportunities to mix and connect throughout the week.
notes: Description is from Soapbox (2026-09-15). Homepage 2026 lists "startup clubhouse" as a feature box. In 2025 it was "Hosted at Somerhaus" (venue somerhaus); the 2026 location is not published. Soapbox: "What began as a talent-focused initiative" (the 2023–2024 "Talent Shop").

title: StartupCincy Week Launch Party
description:
Join us at Mellotone for an exclusive Happy Hour celebrating StartupCincy Week 2026!

Let’s raise a glass to our incredible sponsors, the amazing content coming your way, and the vibrant Cincinnati startup community that makes it all possible.

This is your chance to connect with the ecosystem, get excited for the week ahead, and soak it all in before StartupCincy Week's 10th anniversary celebration kicks off!

P.S. STILL NEED A TICKET TO STARTUPCINCY WEEK? Grab yours here.
notes: Pre-week happy hour on Cintrifuse's public Luma calendar (luma.com/cintrifuseevents), found in the verification pass; not on the SCW agenda. It takes place on 2026-09-24, before the Oct 5–8 week (and before the Oct 3–11 guide window). Luma lists public RSVPs as "featured guests"; they are attendees, not speakers, so they are not recorded.
